I answered Marcus in a thread on his message in #north-team: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 25 November.

That date comes from Ilse's 14 Oct message in #north-team. Marcus is a member of that channel, so he can see it too, and a renewal date is fine to share with the account's team. Nobody has posted a different date since then. There are still no Brackenwater files on the share, so Ilse's message is the only source. I told Marcus that in the reply.
